senses.gloss: m. (חרת, sec. r. of חרה, v. חֶרְיָה) dried up by heat, shrunk.
units: Succ. 32ᵃ top ח׳ פסול if the palm-branch is dried up, it is unfit for use; דומה לח׳ if it only looks as if dried up (blackish) &c.—Fem. חֲרוּתָה.

<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 3:2">Ḥull. III, 2</cite> <he>ח׳ בידי שמים</he> if the animal’s lungs are shrunk (wood-like) through an accident; <cite ref="Chullin 55b:9">ib. 55ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ בידי אדם</he> by violence done to it.
Tosef. ib. III, 12 אי זוהי ח׳ וכ׳ what animal is called ḥărutha?—Answ. whose lungs are shrunk.

senses.gloss: engraven, v. חָרַת. [Y. B. Bath. IV, 14ᶜ bot. חרותין, v. דּוּת.]
